column1: # Per-symbol allowlist for algeon-cudf's `#[doc(hidden)] pub` surface.
# `cargo public-api` omits hidden items, so scripts/ci/check_public_api_hidden.py
# checks this ledger against the source instead of a snapshot. Every hidden
# symbol has its own row: methods as `Type::method`, trait impl methods as
# `<Type as Trait>::method`, fields as `Type.field`, and `pub use` leaves by the
# name they introduce. A test-hooks or bench-support module row also covers its
# unattributed children. `feature` is derived from the item's cfg; `cross-crate`
# means it needs none of the seam features. `consumer` is what
# `prod: …; tools: …; tests: …`: `prod` is library and server code, `tools` is
# bench, examples, tools, and workloads code, and `tests` is test targets,
# cfg(test) code, and code that compiles only with test-hooks. A symbol no crate
# names records `exposed-by: <public symbols>` that reach it through a signature
